week1: baseline: 7 zh-Hant and up to 7 en; quality failures may reduce posts
week2: 7 zh-Hant; up to 5 en and 2 ja replacing en on experiment days9,12; never add slots
confounding: language initially coupled to slot; observational comparison, not causal language effect. No time changes during baseline. Hold topic/style comparable where possible.
two_week_rule: If two comparable mature weeks show no material growth, inspect distribution/data then change one variable. Insufficient sample means extend observation, not invent success.
brand: keep name; no full rebrand based on a single post

week1_observation.interpretation: Not a causal result: time-language and publication-frequency confounding; Nov 1 incomplete; equal-age and reach missing.
